dispositions.sourceDisposition: Recognizes an externally supplied major-part economic-life assessment within qualitative finance/operating lease classification at inception. The Standard mandates no 75% cutoff; examples and indicators are not conclusive. Document substance, transfer of substantially all risks and rewards, and countervailing features; a ratio alone does not determine classification.
remaining: Reviewed entity-specific accounting judgment and expected outcomes

dispositions.sourceDisposition: Recognizes an externally supplied substantially-all fair-value assessment within qualitative finance/operating lease classification. No 90% cutoff is mandated. Assess risks and rewards and countervailing features at inception; this ratio recognizer alone does not classify the lease.
remaining: Reviewed entity-specific accounting judgment and expected outcomes

dispositions.sourceDisposition: Recognizes an externally supplied SME finance-lease initial-measurement assertion for a lessee after evidenced classification. Use the lower of inception fair value and present value of minimum lease payments as the liability/base asset amount; add qualifying initial direct costs to the asset. Use the implicit rate if determinable, otherwise the incremental borrowing rate. The legacy ROU identifier does not import a full-IFRS measurement model or operating-lease capitalization.
remaining: Reviewed entity-specific accounting judgment and expected outcomes

dispositions.sourceDisposition: Recognizes an externally supplied compliance assertion only; its token does not establish an unreserved compliance statement. The connected workflow must verify an approved complete requirement/disclosure inventory, exact current reviewed evidence, eligibility, edition and statement bundle, with unresolved requirements blocking readiness. A separate independent accounting conclusion and release authorization remain required.
remaining: Reviewed entity-specific accounting judgment and expected outcomes
